sniffyoutube.py.name: Playlist and combined site report
sniffyoutube.py.description: Defines channel, playlist and watch-page parsers plus Youku/Tencent helpers, then writes a combined dated CSV from local lists. The chinaSina sketch is inside a string, not executable code.

metasniffer.py.name: OpenGraph metadata exporter
metasniffer.py.description: Imports playListSniff, reads playlist URLs, fetches each video watch page and writes title, description and tag-list rows to metaSniff.csv.

chinaTest.py.name: Standalone Tencent request experiment
chinaTest.py.description: Reads a local input list at module level, creates requests sessions with browser-like headers, parses Tencent title/count selectors and prints results with delays.
